content: useLiveQuery(querier, deps, defaultResult) — deps array works exactly like useEffect deps. Pass dynamic parameters via closure and include in deps. Example: useLiveQuery(() => db.medicines.toCollection().filter(m => m.name.toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase())).sortBy('name'), [q]). Returns undefined while loading (show skeleton), then T. Client-side filter after full fetch is the standard pattern for substring search since IndexedDB indexes do not support contains-match. startsWithIgnoreCase() covers prefix only.
